SpydraAPIKeyCredential.title: Spydra API Key
SpydraAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In your Spydra Network, open API Keys and create or copy an API key. Paste the network's Asset Tokenization REST API base URL, including /tokenize/<chaincodeccid>, from the app's REST API page. The key is network-specific. NoClick sends it as X-API-KEY to this deployment; use only your trusted Spydra deployment URL.
